scenes.title: Agata and the Demons
scenes.rationale: The opening council reviews the Old Woman of the Dusts and the demon encounter, ending with Candrosa’s explanation that demons require a summoner.
scenes.overview: Compare accounts of Agata and her bargains; discuss the demons at Raven’s Hold and who might have summoned them.
scenes.transitionToNext: Kenzo returns to the map and asks Alesh about the southern gnolls, shifting from magical causes to movements and timing.

scenes.title: Gnolls and Shakun’s Protection
scenes.rationale: The council turns to the gnolls’ movements and condition, then the failure of Karawa’s protection; Candrosa’s withdrawal closes the encounter.
scenes.overview: Trace gnolls and orc scouts, then question Candrosa about Shakun’s protection and his silence.
scenes.transitionToNext: Candrosa withdraws to pray and Alesh prepares to leave; the party turns to its next move and supplies.

scenes.title: Preparing an Eastern Expedition
scenes.rationale: The party’s deliberation and practical follow-up with Havdar form a single planning situation before the explicit arrival at the centaur camp.
scenes.overview: Weigh Agata, Kharsan, and the stone house; discuss water, horses, armor repairs, and joining Havdar.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party approaches Tharandros’s camp for a new conversation over food and wine.

scenes.title: Echo Realms and Karawa’s Silence
scenes.rationale: The first half of the centaur conversation explores Agata, the echo realms, and the unnatural silence over Karawa, ending with warnings about bargaining with Agata.
scenes.overview: Learn Tharandros’s account of the echo realms and explore possible explanations for Karawa’s silence.
scenes.transitionToNext: Seeker asks about travel between planes, moving the discussion toward crossings and practical next steps.

scenes.title: Crossings and the Road East
scenes.rationale: The conversation shifts to crossings, the centaurs’ continued presence, and the eastern expedition; the ensuing table debrief closes the group session.
scenes.overview: Discuss crossings, establish that the centaurs will remain, and settle on riding east with Havdar.
scenes.transitionToNext: The group session wraps up; Kenzo and the DM continue privately, then place a separate meeting later that evening.

scenes.title: Kenzo’s Private Questions
scenes.rationale: Kenzo’s private follow-up is a distinct encounter with restricted character knowledge, centered on his dreams, jade, and the Order of the Awakened Soul.
scenes.overview: Discuss Kenzo’s dreams and jade, consider the staff as a possible siege target, and find a lead to the Awakened Soul.
